title: Anisotropic gold nanochains with dual-ligand interfaces for theranostic immune activation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15410-15419
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00281A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chungmo Yang, Young Ju Son, Sila Jin, Yeonju Park, Young Mee Jung, Seung Goo Kang, Hyuk Sang Yoo
Gold nanorods functionalized with azide assemble end-to-end into nanochains. The Fc-modified chains engage NK cells via receptor recognition, significantly enhancing antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) in a chain length-dependent manner.
